game_start.intro: Inkhel tan a ni. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump card: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Nin hi Player {player_id} ni, German Whist-ah.
{phase_info}
Nin hian card {hand_size} nei.
Card phar hna i duh chuan '[play N]' ti rawh, N hi a position a ni (example: '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: HMANNAH CHUAN: Trick tin a hnehtu chuan card hmai lam chu a la ang a, chak lo tu erawh chuan an dawhkan aṭanga card dang hi a lak leh bawk. He stage-a trick hmuhte hian hnehna chanpual atan chhiar tel loh ani dawn a ni.
player_prompt.phase_playing: HUNTIN: Deck a kim tawh. Tun aṭangin thil tih tum tinrêngte chuan hnehna an thlen thei ang.

next_card.playing_phase: Card eng mah a awm lo - khelh ṭan tawh.
next_card.deck_empty: A dawhkan chu a reh - card eng mah an pe lo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A dik lo a. I kut chhunga Nth card khelh nân '[play N]' hmang ang che.
invalid_move.bad_position: Chu card position chu a awm lo. I kutah chuan {hand_size} cards i keng e.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: I zui tûr a ni, {lead_suit} card i khel ang.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Chu card chu khelh theih a ni lo.

trick.won: Player {winner_id} chuan {card} a hmuin trick a chak.
trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} chuan {card} a hmuin trick a chak a, face-up card a la dawng.

phase.learning_complete: Deck chu a kim ta. Zirna phai hi a zo ta - a bak trick dang zawng zawng hi chakna lam pan a ni.

draw.winner_received: Trick i hneh a, {card} chu i dawng ta.
draw.loser_received: I hloh a, i draw {card} ta mai.
draw.winner_preview: A dawttu card chu {card} a ni.

turn.scores_learning: Tricks an hmu tawh - Player 0: {tricks0}, Player 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: He trick hi card khelh a la ni lo.

board_str.not_started: Game a la ṭan lo va.
